notes: Definition change, restoring the pinned meaning (#33373, option 1). SelfDual μ B contains μ.IsAddHaarMeasure, whose IsAddLeftInvariant parent says Measure.map (g + ·) μ = μ for all g. Mathlib's Measure.map of a map that is not a.e. measurable changed from 0 to dirac Classical.ofNonempty for a nonzero measure (PORTING.md, reused-name table), and V is not assumed to be a topological group, so the unchanged text accepted measures that the pinned definition rejected (counterexample in #33373). With the pinned map, IsOpenPosMeasure gives μ ≠ 0, so the pinned definition forces every translation to be a.e. measurable. The new definition states this as a conjunct: (μ.IsAddHaarMeasure ∧ ∀ g : V, AEMeasurable (fun v => g + v) μ) ∧ (the unchanged fourB condition). It is equivalent to the pinned meaning for every V, μ and B, proved in Lean on the target (pSelfDual_iff_selfDual in M004788-DefEquiv.lean, linked from the PR; axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound) against the pinned Measure.map and IsAddHaarMeasure of Mathlib 0df444a3. The model replaces only Measure.map and the class unfolding with their pinned forms; the other names it shares with the target (IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts, IsOpenPosMeasure, AEMeasurable, mapₗ, the integral in fourB, IsTest) rest on the reused-name comparison. Nothing else in the file changes, so its other uses of SelfDual (the Et.Meas fields sdK and sdL, WeilField, WeilEt, GammaOne, and RankOne through Et.Meas) keep their pinned meaning with unchanged text. Not addressed here: Et.IsNat states ν.IsHaarMeasure for ν on unitary A.L, which reaches Measure.map the same way, through IsMulLeftInvariant, and instance search finds no MeasurableMul there. It is believed unchanged: on the target, IsHaarMeasure on a T1 group with BorelSpace already forces every left translation to be a.e. measurable (proved in Lean), but T1Space (unitary A.L) has not been checked in Lean. It belongs to the separate review of IsHaarMeasure-style uses. When translations are measurable (MeasurableAdd V) the new conjunct holds automatically; proofs that construct a SelfDual supply it with (measurable_const_add g).aemeasurable, and proofs that take one apart use .1.1 for IsAddHaarMeasure.
